thesis: Not one city but three films that share a map. Baltimere is the city he leaves: intimate, sodium-orange, seen through glass, a city of exits. Atlantis is the city he is let into: a night that is a stage, warm below and cold above, built in layers so that every move is up or down. The Shore is the city he rebuilds: weather, ruin and morning, where time-lapse is the native tense. Each district inside them has one mood, one hour it is seen at, one light technology and one way of moving the camera. The poems happen in particular rooms, stairs and curbs of particular districts, and the cuts between poems are physical places too: an elevator shaft, a perimeter fence, a rail viaduct, a haze on the water.

joins.name: The archive
joins.is: 58,141 images and keyframes read by CLIP (ViT-B-32): search by meaning, by poem, by source
joins.here: the same model now reads the 100 views, the poems' 90 set pieces and 149 frames of the movie map's disc, so all of them sit in one space
joins.finds: the views are a new continent: on average their nearest canon shot is at cos 0.62, where canon shots sit at 0.81 from each other; only view 71 lands inside the canon
joins.next: publish the views as an archive source so search finds them; every new generation joins the same space

joins.name: The imageable city
joins.is: 2,707 canon shots read as Lynch's five elements and drawn back into a plan
joins.here: each view's nearest canon shots are its witnesses; where the canon placed those shots in the city is evidence for where a district belongs
joins.finds: the canon reads almost everything as nightlife, industrial or downtown: it has no words yet for platforms in the cloud, drowned atria or fences of light
joins.next: add the views' own Lynch reading (landmark, path, edge, node, district) so they can be placed by the same rule

joins.name: The foundry
joins.is: 1,632 islands grown grid-first by MAP-Elites and read against the poems; camera stands that turn to what he names
joins.here: the islands score on how well they hold the poems; they never score on mood
joins.finds: the grid epochs (L-system, tensor, radial) already give each district a street grammar: Naraka is the maze, the Overseer the regular grid, the Haze the expressway ring
joins.next: add a mood niche: render each poem's camera stand and score it against its district's centroid in CLIP, so the evolution keeps worlds that look like the views

joins.name: Inverse topology
joins.is: 28 reference landscapes: the best camera is searched in each world, then the missing regions (water, ridge, city) are grown and re-shot
joins.here: about fifteen of the views are legible landscapes the same method can answer: 23 and 33 (aerials), 12 and 70 (spire fields), 25 (towers over a basin), 35 (skyline over the sea), 64 (haze skyline), 69 (the city from above)
joins.finds: most views are interiors and close streets: they ask for buildings, not land, which is what the heroes compiler is for
joins.next: run inverse.py on those fifteen against city3d's plan: grow the basin under the Overseer, the cloud deck under Ankhu, the haze volume over the industrial district

joins.name: The gazetteer
joins.is: the world bible: six eras, the tide calendar, institutions, icons, districts by use per era
joins.here: every district here carries its six-era history in the gazetteer's terms, its institution, and the light technology of the era that made it, which is how colour maps onto time
joins.finds: the gazetteer's districts are land uses; these are moods; both are kept: the use says what the stones are for, the mood says how the film sees them
joins.next: add mood, hour and the views to each district entry; the Night of the Line and Relighting become shots

joins.name: Hero buildings
joins.is: six story buildings described once (HDL), compiled inside and out, proved buildable, staged with the poem's beats
joins.here: sixteen new heroes are written in the same form: brief, beats (set pieces), facts tagged reference / inferred / invented / exists / open, a setting and what they build on
joins.finds: the existing six already sit in these districts: the Severn (Haze), the chapel and white temple (Temple), the NEW SINGLE (Naraka's neighbour), the pier café (Bay), the clock tower (Temple), the rowhouse (Overseer)
joins.next: compile the shaft, the House and the Orange Catwalk first: they carry three transitions

joins.name: The design language
joins.is: the rules: the flood datum, kintsugi, additions, stairs are streets, the tide, skinned with its own footage, the Line and the Seam
joins.here: its district palettes are measured from archive evidence and come out grey; the views give each district its glow; a district's colour is two layers: body from the archive, light from the views
joins.finds: every rule holds in every district: the line rides the catwalk rails, the shaft's landings, the canopy's clearance, the names on the viaduct
joins.next: the colour tokens gain a district layer: haze sodium, Naraka teal and pink, Ankhu violet, Overseer moon blue, Arcade red-blue, Temple white

joins.name: The movie map and its film
joins.is: the city filmed every 3 m at noon in four views; the film's camera driven by his voice
joins.here: 149 frames of the disc in the same space: they look like each other (0.92) and like neither the canon (0.64) nor the views (0.45)
joins.finds: the city we render is a third island: one mood everywhere; 120 of 149 street frames read as Mirror Thread Bay's pale water light
joins.next: district light in the engine (fog, lamp colour, neon, hour), then re-shoot the disc and measure it again: the target is for the disc to spread across the districts and move toward the views
